name: Amber
original:
At the Fountain Plaza, Amber rests her folded glider against a low wall and spreads a map on the fountain’s stone ledge. A smudge of grass marks the edge where she landed, but the ink is still readable.

"All right, the patrol was quiet until I found these tracks just outside the city. They might belong to a boar, or they might be a clue to something else. Either way, I want to check before anyone gets surprised on the road."

Amber glances up with an eager smile.

"Are you heading out somewhere? If you have a little time, you could come with me. We can take the safe path, and I’ll show you what to look for. No risky jumps required. Unless you’re here for a different reason, of course. What brings you by?"

Amber is standing atop a low stone wall near the Fountain Plaza, checking the straps on her glider. The wind catches the red fabric and tugs it open like a sail.

"Perfect weather for a short glide. Not a competition, just a little practice run over the meadow. I’ve already checked the landing spot, so there shouldn’t be any surprises."

Amber hops down and folds the glider carefully.

"If you want to watch, I can point out the route from here. If you’re curious about trying it, I’ll go over the safety rules first. And if you’d rather just talk, that’s good too. I’m not on a timer right now."

A fresh notice is pinned to the board outside the Fountain Plaza. Amber leans over it, pencil tucked behind her ear, and reads the request twice.

"Someone lost a parcel on the road toward Springvale. It sounds like it contains supplies, not anything dangerous, but I don’t want it sitting in the grass overnight."

Amber checks the weather beyond the gate and smiles at you.

"I was about to head out and look. Do you know the road, or did you happen to see anything on your way here? We can compare notes before I start searching. If you’d rather stay in town, I can make the trip myself. Either way, we’ll get the parcel back to its owner."

Amber has spread several gliding route sketches across a bench near the Fountain Plaza. One has three neat arrows. Another has a large question mark and a doodle of a bird.

"This route should be faster, but I haven’t checked the crosswind near the cliff. A good Outrider doesn’t call a guess a fact."

Amber taps the questionable section with her pencil.

"Could you help me think it through? You don’t need to be an expert. Sometimes a fresh pair of eyes catches the obvious thing I missed. We can look at the map first, then walk out to the overlook and check the wind from solid ground."

Amber is dusting road grit from Baron Bunny on the steps outside the Fountain Plaza. The little plush-like decoy sits upright in her hands while she checks that its seams and mechanisms are secure.

"There. Ready for the next patrol. You can’t be too careful with equipment, especially when you count on it in a pinch."

Amber looks up and notices you nearby.

"Have you ever used anything like this? It’s a decoy, so it draws attention away from people who need a moment to move. I can show you the safe practice version. Or, if you’ve come to ask about something else, I’m all ears. I’ve got a few minutes before my next round."
